item.strong: SRS v1 · Software Requirements Specification (SRS) Overview for Payment Platform forSmall

srs.title: Software Requirements Specification (SRS) Overview for Payment Platform forSmall
srs.summary: This SRS overview outlines the requirements for a payment platform tailored for small businesses in India. The platform will support merchants, Bank Officers, and Auditors with features including payment links, transaction reconciliation, refunds, and reporting. It will integrate with a payment gate
assumptions: The payment gateway integration is already established or will be handled by an external vendor.
Regulatory requirements for data retention and security are in line with RBI guidelines (E2).
The platform will operate within the existing infrastructure of the banking system and payment ecosystem.
stakeholders: Merchants: Users of the platform who need to make payments, manage transactions, and generate reports.
Bank Officers: Personnel responsible for approving release versions and overseeing the security and compliance of the platform.
Auditors: Individuals tasked with reviewing the platform's operations and ensuring adherence to regulatory standards.
Payment Gateway Provider: Entity responsible for processing payments and integrating with the platform.

findings.text: The brief does not specify the exact security controls required, which are critical given the RBI guidelines (E2).
The data retention policy for audit trails is mentioned as indefinite, but no specific regulatory references are cited.
The reconciliation mechanism is referenced in E1, but the specifics of how it will be implemented are not detailed in the answers.

risks.title: Security Compliance Risk
risks.text: Failure to comply with RBI security controls could result in regulatory penalties. The platform must ensure robust security measures as per E2 and E3.

risks.title: Data Retention Risk
risks.text: The indefinite data retention policy may pose legal or compliance risks if not aligned with evolving regulations.

openIssues: What are the specific security controls required for the platform, as per RBI guidelines?
How will the reconciliation mechanism be implemented in real time or near-real time as per E1?

requirements.statement: The payment platform must support role-based access control with specific user roles including Merchants, Bank Officers, and Auditors.
requirements.acceptance: Role-based access control must be implemented with the defined roles, and users must be assigned to these roles accordingly.

requirements.statement: The platform should handle up to 10,000 transactions per day.
requirements.acceptance: The system must be capable of processing a minimum of 10,000 transactions within a 24-hour period without performance degradation.

requirements.statement: Release versions of the platform must be approved by the Head of Payment Systems.
requirements.acceptance: The Head of Payment Systems must approve all release versions before they are deployed to production environments.

requirements.statement: Audit trails and transaction logs must be retained indefinitely as per regulatory requirements.
requirements.acceptance: All audit trails and transaction logs must be stored for an indefinite period, ensuring they are accessible for auditing purposes.

requirements.statement: The platform must integrate with a payment gateway to facilitate payments.
requirements.acceptance: Integration with at least one approved payment gateway must be in place, and the integration must function seamlessly with the platform.

requirements.statement: The platform must provide payment links for merchants to facilitate payments.
requirements.acceptance: Merchants must be able to generate and share payment links through the platform, with these links being functional and secure.

requirements.statement: The platform must support transaction reconciliation in real-time or near-real-time (not later than 24 hours from the time of receipt of settlement file(s)).
requirements.acceptance: All digital payment transactions must be reconciled within 24 hours of receiving the settlement files, with discrepancies identified and resolved promptly.

requirements.statement: The platform must provide refunds and reporting features for merchants.
requirements.acceptance: Merchants must be able to request refunds through the platform, and detailed reporting tools must be available for analyzing transactions and performance.

requirements.statement: The platform must ensure data security and compliance with regulatory requirements related to digital payments in India.
requirements.acceptance: The platform must comply with all applicable regulations, including those regarding data security, privacy, and transaction integrity as outlined by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

requirements.statement: The platform must have a robust capacity management plan to meet evolving demand and ensure scalability.
requirements.acceptance: The IT infrastructure must be designed to handle increasing transaction volumes and user base, with regular reviews of the system's capacity to ensure it meets current and future需求
